seed_data_creation: Ephemeral TEST_* users created and deleted via admin endpoint within tests — no leftover state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter98_security.py is the new regression suite for SEC-001 (password strength) + admin cleanup tools. Reuse for future iterations. All 18 tests green.
